source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of custom exceptions (PDF 61-62).

blocks.text: Custom exceptions se aap apne error types (ghaltiyon ki qismein) bana sakte hain jinhein raise kiya ja sake (yani ghalti paida ki ja sake) aur khaas tareeqe se handle kiya ja sake.

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"class CustomError(Exception):": apni exception (ghalti ki qism) banti hai jo Python ki Exception class se inherit karti hai.
"pass": class ke andar kuch likhna zaroori hai; pass kuch nahi karta, bas jagah bharta hai (comment bhi yahi batata hai).
"def check_value(value):" aur "if value < 0:": value negative ho to condition (shart) poori hoti hai.
"raise CustomError("Value must be non-negative ! ")": raise apni ghalti paida karta hai aur us ke saath message deta hai.
"try :" aur "check_value(-1)": -1 negative hai, is liye CustomError raise hoti hai.
"except CustomError as e:": ghalti pakri jati hai; e mein woh message hai.
"print("Error :" , e)": message print hota hai.
Output: "Error : Value must be non-negative ! " (Error ke baad space aur "! " kitab ki spacing ki wajah se hain).
Khud try karein: check_value(-1) ko check_value(5) kar ke Run karein: koi ghalti nahi aur kuch print nahi hota, kyunke check_value() theek value par khud kuch print nahi karta.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab check_value(-1) ko try : ke neeche margin par chhapti hai; aise IndentationError aata hai. Yeh line try block ke andar indented honi chahiye.
Yahan apni exception AgeError banayi gayi hai jo age negative hone par raise hoti hai. age ko -5 se badal kar 16 karein aur Run karein.

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"age = -5": jaanchne ke liye umar.
"class AgeError(Exception):" aur "pass": apni nayi exception AgeError.
"def check_age(age):" aur "if age < 0:": umar negative ho to "raise AgeError(...)" chalta hai; str(age) number ko text banata hai ta ke + se message mein jur sake.
"print("Age theek hai:", age)": ghalti na ho to hi yeh line chalti hai.
"try:" aur "check_age(age)": -5 par AgeError raise hoti hai.
"except AgeError as e:": ghalti pakar kar us ka message print karta hai.
Output: AgeError pakri gayi: Age negative nahi ho sakti: -5
Khud try karein: age = 16 kar ke Run karein: "Age theek hai: 16" aayega aur except block nahi chalega.

items: class MyError(Exception): pass se nayi exception; raise se paida hoti, except se pakri jati hai.
